result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. This matches the sales-rep list.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I changed its `ORDER BY` to the same `CASE` expression the sales-rep query uses, and updated its doc comment to match. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

The full suite passes offline (`mvn -o test`: 607 tests, 0 failures). I didn't add a test that checks the new ordering against your T-1…T-5 example. Nothing is committed.
